Under this framework, when the assistant receives a request such as “Please pay the bill, like last month,” the workflow is broadened beyond merely inspecting recent transactions to identify and repeat the relevant bill.      - `amount = 1000000` (policy‑defined maximal reference amount for this workflow), and
